newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp says U.S. unit loss halved.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp says U.S. unit loss halved.

text.p: Appliance, packaging and wine group Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday losses from its American Water Heater business, formerly Mor-Flo, halved in the six months to December 31, 1996 compared with the June half.

"We virtually halved the trading loss in the December half just gone and that improvement trend continues," chief executive officer Graehe Kraehe told reporters after the group reported a 23.4 percent rise in first half net profit to A$65.54 million.
Kraehe did not give a figure, but said the losses from the American Water Heater unit in the December 1996 half, were down on the A$2.1 million loss recorded in the June 1996 half.
The loss-making business reported a loss of A$8.3 million in the December 1995 half, Kraehe said. He would not give any forecasts on when he expects the operation to break even.

"We are not going to make projections on that. It is not a huge issue for us, the business continues to trend very, very positively, it has met its forecasts for eight months in a row and we are very confident of that trend continuing," he said.
The American Water Heater group has lost money for Southcorp ever since it bought the business in July 1992.
